description: Satellite Detected Waters over Zaporizhzhia Power Plant, Zaporizka Oblast in Ukraine as of 09 June 2023 is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code FL20230606UKR This map illustrates satellite-detected surface waters using Sentinel-1 images acquired on the 09th of June 2023 at 15:36 UTC. Within the analysed area of 260 km², along the Dnieper River, surface waters appear to have receded by about 12km². Coverage: Zaporizhzhia Power Plant area, Zaporizka Oblast. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are flooding, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2025-08-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike (CC BY-SA). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
